codecUiPolicies.interpretation: Three-argument optional stores an Optional-returning MapCodec override. Four-argument optional stores a default. mapCodecFor uses the override first; otherwise a non-null optional default selects optionalFieldOf, and the remaining path selects fieldOf.
toSchemaField copies optional/default metadata independently of the actual MapCodec. The explicit MapCodec field overload also sets optional=true and default=null.
Both wrappers delegate encode/decode to their underlying Codec. Lazy schema access invokes its schema supplier; schema access and value decoding are distinct operations.
inferenceMode reports construction-interception MIXIN or REFLECTION. The selected fixture supplies an explicit primitive schema and does not qualify either inference path.

resolve bootstraps curated schemas, uses per-thread identity caching, and considers tags, custom handlers, structural and reflective paths. Field locators do not establish the active runtime inference result.
